title: APMEX Silver Bar Premiums
takeaway: APMEX’s average premium on 1kg silver bars is 2.75%.

data.label: APMEX Silver Bar Premium
data.evidence: As of today, August 9, 2026, the average premium for silver bullion bars (1 kg) is 2.75%. This means you’ll pay approximately $32.25 per ounce above the spot price.

narration: APMEX operates on a markup system, adding a premium to the spot price of metals. As of August 9, 2026, their average premium on 1kg silver bars is 2.75%. This premium covers operating costs and profit margins, and it fluctuates with market conditions.
